translations.literal: Fang grew angry, took the petition and wrote upon it, "Your father murdered the Sui sovereign, and you petition for Sui perquisites—is that permissible?"
translations.idiomatic: Fang grew angry, took the petition and wrote upon it, "Your father murdered the Sui sovereign, and you petition for Sui perquisites—is that permissible?"

sentences.zh: 人服其敏。

translations.literal: People admired his quick wit.
translations.idiomatic: People admired his quick wit.

sentences.zh: 終工部尚書。

translations.literal: He ended as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 盧承慶

translations.literal: Lu Chengqing
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chengqing

sentences.zh: 盧承慶，字子餘，幽州涿人，隋散騎侍郎思道之孫。

translations.literal: Lu Chengqing, courtesy name Ziyu, was a native of Zhuo in You Prefecture and grandson of Lu Sidao, Attendant Cavalier under the Sui.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Chengqing, courtesy name Ziyu, was a native of Zhuo in You Prefecture and grandson of Lu Sidao, attendant cavalier under the Sui.

sentences.zh: 父赤松，為河東令，與高祖雅故，聞兵興，迎見霍邑，拜行台兵部郎中，終率更令、范陽郡公。

translations.literal: His father Chisong was magistrate of Hedong; an old acquaintance of Gaozu, when he heard troops were rising he went to meet him at Huoyi and was appointed bureau director in the military section of the mobile secretariat; he ended as Director of the Directorate of Water Clocks and Duke of Fanyang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chisong was magistrate of Hedong; an old acquaintance of Gaozu, when he heard troops were rising he went to meet him at Huoyi and was appointed bureau director in the military section of the mobile secretariat; he ended as director of the directorate of water clocks and duke of Fanyang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 承慶美儀矩，博學而才。

translations.literal: Chengqing had handsome bearing and deportment, was broadly learned, and possessed talent.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqing had handsome bearing and deportment, was broadly learned, and possessed talent.

sentences.zh: 少襲爵。

translations.literal: In youth he inherited his father's title.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he inherited his father's title.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，為秦州參軍，入奏軍事，太宗偉其辯，擢考功員外郎。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhenguan he served as adjutant of Qin Prefecture; when he entered court to report on military affairs, Taizong was impressed by his eloquence and promoted him to vice bureau director in the Ministry for Evaluating Merit.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhenguan he served as adjutant of Qin Prefecture; when he entered court to report on military affairs, Taizong was impressed by his eloquence and promoted him to vice bureau director in the Ministry for Evaluating Merit.

sentences.zh: 累遷民部侍郎。

translations.literal: After repeated promotions he became Vice Minister of the Household.
translations.idiomatic: After repeated promotions he became vice minister of the household.

sentences.zh: 帝問歷代戶版，承慶敘夏、商至周、隋增損曲折，引據該詳，帝嗟賞。

translations.literal: When the Emperor asked about household registers through the ages, Chengqing recounted the twists of increase and decrease from Xia and Shang through Zhou and Sui, citing sources comprehensively and in detail; the Emperor sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor asked about household registers through the ages, Chengqing recounted the twists of increase and decrease from Xia and Shang through Zhou and Sui, citing sources comprehensively and in detail; the emperor sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 俄兼檢校兵部侍郎，知五品選，辭曰：「選事在尚書，臣掌之為出位。」

translations.literal: Soon he was concurrently appointed Acting Vice Minister of War and put in charge of selection for fifth-rank posts; he declined, saying, "Selection belongs to the Ministry of Personnel; for me to oversee it would be overstepping my station."
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was concurrently appointed acting vice minister of war and put in charge of selection for fifth-rank posts; he declined, saying, "Selection belongs to the Ministry of Personnel; for me to oversee it would be overstepping my station."

sentences.zh: 帝不許，曰：「朕信卿，卿何不自信？」

translations.literal: The Emperor did not permit this and said, "I trust you—why do you not trust yourself?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not permit this and said, "I trust you—why do you not trust yourself?"

sentences.zh: 曆雍州別駕、尚書左丞。

translations.literal: He successively served as vice prefect of Yong Prefecture and Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as vice prefect of Yong Prefecture and left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 高宗永徽時，坐事貶簡州司馬。

translations.literal: During Yonghui under Gaozong he was demoted for an offense to military aide of Jian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During Yonghui under Gaozong he was demoted for an offense to military aide of Jian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 閱歲，改洪州長史。

translations.literal: After a year he was transferred to chief administrator of Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was transferred to chief administrator of Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 帝將幸汝湯泉，故拜汝州刺史。

translations.literal: Because the Emperor was about to visit the hot springs at Ru, Chengqing was appointed prefect of Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor was about to visit the hot springs at Ru, Chengqing was appointed prefect of Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 顯慶四年，以度支尚書同中書門下三品，坐調非法，免。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianqing, as Minister of Revenue with the status of Associate Chancellor of the Third Rank, he was dismissed for irregularities in fiscal regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianqing, as minister of revenue with the status of associate chancellor of the third rank, he was dismissed for irregularities in fiscal regulation.

sentences.zh: 俄拜潤州刺史。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed prefect of Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was appointed prefect of Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 拜刑部尚書。

translations.literal: He was appointed Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 以金紫光祿大夫致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He retired with the title of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Purple-gold Seal and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired with the title of grand master of splendid happiness with the purple-gold seal and died.

sentences.zh: 臨終，誡其子曰：「死生至理，猶朝有暮。

translations.literal: On his deathbed he admonished his sons, saying, "Life and death are the ultimate principle—it is like morning having its evening.
translations.idiomatic: On his deathbed he admonished his sons, saying, "Life and death are the ultimate principle—it is like morning having its evening.

sentences.zh: 吾死，斂以常服，晦朔無薦牲，葬勿卜日，器用陶漆，棺而不槨，墳高可識，碑誌著官號年月，無用虛文。」

translations.literal: When I die, dress me in ordinary clothes; at the new and full moons offer no sacrificial animals; do not choose an auspicious day for burial; use pottery and lacquer for vessels; a coffin but no outer case; make the mound high enough to identify; let the stele record only office, title, and dates—no empty rhetoric."
translations.idiomatic: When I die, dress me in ordinary clothes; at the new and full moons offer no sacrificial animals; do not choose an auspicious day for burial; use pottery and lacquer for vessels; a coffin but no outer case; make the mound high enough to identify; let the stele record only office, title, and dates—no empty rhetoric."

sentences.zh: 贈幽州都督，諡曰定。

translations.literal: He was posthumously appointed Area Commander of You Prefecture; his posthumous name was Ding.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously appointed area commander of You Prefecture; his posthumous name was Ding.

sentences.zh: 初，承慶典選，校百官考，有坐漕舟溺者，承慶以「失所載，考中下」。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Chengqing oversaw selection, he reviewed officials' performance evaluations; one man had been punished for drowning in a grain transport boat, and Chengqing rated him "lost his cargo—grade: lower middle."
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Chengqing oversaw selection, he reviewed officials' performance evaluations; one man had been punished for drowning in a grain transport boat, and Chengqing rated him "lost his cargo—grade: lower middle."

sentences.zh: 以示其人，無慍也。

translations.literal: When he showed this to the man, the man displayed no anger.
translations.idiomatic: When he showed this to the man, the man displayed no anger.

sentences.zh: 更曰「非力所及，考中中」。

translations.literal: Chengqing changed it to "beyond one's strength—grade: middle middle."
translations.idiomatic: Chengqing changed it to "beyond one's strength—grade: middle middle."

sentences.zh: 亦不喜。

translations.literal: The man was still not pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The man was still not pleased.

sentences.zh: 承慶嘉之曰：「寵辱不驚，考中上。」

translations.literal: Chengqing commended him, saying, "Unmoved by favor or disgrace—grade: upper middle."
translations.idiomatic: Chengqing commended him, saying, "Unmoved by favor or disgrace—grade: upper middle."

sentences.zh: 其能著人善類此。

translations.literal: His ability to recognize and praise people's virtues was of this sort.
translations.idiomatic: His ability to recognize and praise people's virtues was of this sort.

sentences.zh: 弟承業、承泰。

translations.literal: His younger brothers were Chengye and Chengtai.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers were Chengye and Chengtai.

sentences.zh: 承業繼為雍州長史、尚書左丞，有能名。

translations.literal: Chengye successively served as chief administrator of Yong Prefecture and Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs and was known for his competence.
translations.idiomatic: Chengye successively served as chief administrator of Yong Prefecture and left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs and was known for his competence.

sentences.zh: 侄 齊卿

translations.literal: Nephew: Qiqing
translations.idiomatic: Nephew: Qiqing

sentences.zh: 承泰，字齊卿，長安初，為雍州參軍。

translations.literal: Chengtai, courtesy name Qiqing, at the beginning of the Chang'an era served as adjutant of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chengtai, courtesy name Qiqing, at the beginning of the Chang'an era served as adjutant of Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 武后詔長史薛季昶擇僚吏堪御史者，季昶訪于齊卿。

translations.literal: Empress Wu ordered Chief Administrator Xue Jichang to select subordinates fit to become censors; Jichang consulted Qiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Wu ordered chief administrator Xue Jichang to select subordinates fit to become censors; Jichang consulted Qiqing.

sentences.zh: 齊卿白長安尉盧懷慎、李休光，萬年尉李乂、崔湜，咸陽丞倪若水，盩厔尉田崇壁，新豐尉崔日用。

translations.literal: Qiqing named the Chang'an district captains Lu Huaishen and Li Xiuguang, the Wannian captains Li Yi and Cui Shi, the assistant magistrate of Xianyang Ni Ruoshui, the Zhouzhi district captain Tian Chongbi, and the Xinfeng district captain Cui Riyong.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqing named the Chang'an district captains Lu Huaishen and Li Xiuguang, the Wannian captains Li Yi and Cui Shi, the assistant magistrate of Xianyang Ni Ruoshui, the Zhouzhi district captain Tian Chongbi, and the Xinfeng district captain Cui Riyong.

sentences.zh: 季昶用其言，後皆為通顯巨人。

translations.literal: Jichang adopted his recommendations; all later became prominent and towering figures.
translations.idiomatic: Jichang adopted his recommendations; all later became prominent and towering figures.

sentences.zh: 及拜幽州刺史，而張守珪隸果毅，齊卿厚遇，曰：「君十年至節度使。」

translations.literal: When Qiqing was appointed prefect of You Prefecture, Zhang Shougui was enrolled as a guardsman; Qiqing treated him generously and said, "In ten years you will reach the rank of military governor."
translations.idiomatic: When Qiqing was appointed prefect of You Prefecture, Zhang Shougui was enrolled as a guardsman; Qiqing treated him generously and said, "In ten years you will reach the rank of military governor."

sentences.zh: 已而果然。

translations.literal: And so it indeed came to pass.
translations.idiomatic: And so it indeed came to pass.

sentences.zh: 喜飲酒，逾鬥不亂。

translations.literal: He enjoyed drinking; even beyond a peck of wine he did not lose his composure.
translations.idiomatic: He enjoyed drinking; even beyond a peck of wine he did not lose his composure.

sentences.zh: 寬厚樂易，士友以此親之。

translations.literal: Generous, easygoing, and good-natured, scholars and friends drew close to him for these qualities.
translations.idiomatic: Generous, easygoing, and good-natured, scholars and friends drew close to him for these qualities.

sentences.zh: 終太子詹事、廣陽縣公。

translations.literal: He ended as Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and Duke of Guangyang County.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as supervisor of the household of the heir apparent and duke of Guangyang County.

sentences.zh: 承慶從孫藏用別有傳。

translations.literal: Chengqing's great-nephew Zangyong has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: Chengqing's great-nephew Zangyong has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 劉祥道

translations.literal: Liu Xiangdao
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiangdao

sentences.zh: 劉祥道，字同壽，魏州觀城人。

translations.literal: Liu Xiangdao, courtesy name Tongshou, was a man of Guancheng in Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xiangdao, courtesy name Tongshou, was a native of Guancheng in Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父林甫，武德時為內史舍人，典機密，以才稱。

translations.literal: His father Linpu, in the Wude era served as Secretariat Aide, managed confidential affairs, and was famed for talent.
translations.idiomatic: His father Linpu served as a secretariat aide during the Wude era, handled confidential state business, and was renowned for his ability.

sentences.zh: 與蕭瑀等撰定律令，著《律議》萬餘言。

translations.literal: With Xiao Yu and others he drafted statutes and ordinances, and composed the Discourse on Law in more than ten thousand words.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Xiao Yu and others he helped draft statutes and ordinances and wrote the Discourse on Law, more than ten thousand characters long.

sentences.zh: 曆中書、吏部二侍郎，賜爵樂平縣男。

translations.literal: He successively served as Vice Director of the Secretariat and of the Ministry of Personnel, and was enfeoffed as Baron of Leping County.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as vice director of the secretariat and of the ministry of personnel, and was enfeoffed as baron of Leping County.

sentences.zh: 唐沿隋制，十一月選集，至春停，日薄事叢，有司不及研諦。

translations.literal: Tang followed Sui practice: selection was gathered in the eleventh month and halted in spring; days grew short and business piled up, and the responsible offices could not examine matters thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang followed Sui practice, convening official selection in the eleventh month and suspending it in spring; as the days shortened and business piled up, the responsible offices could not examine candidates with due care.

sentences.zh: 林甫建請四時聽選，隨到輒擬，於是官無滯人。

translations.literal: Linpu proposed that selection be heard in all four seasons, with appointments made as soon as candidates arrived; thereafter offices had no backlog of personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Linpu proposed holding selection sessions in all four seasons and making appointments as candidates arrived; from then on no office was left with a backlog of personnel.

sentences.zh: 始，天下初定，州府及詔使以赤牒授官，至是罷，悉集吏部調，至萬員，林甫隨才銓錄，鹹以為宜，論者方隋高孝基。

translations.literal: At first, when the realm had just been settled, prefectures, districts, and imperial envoys appointed officials by red slip; now that was abolished, and all were gathered under the Ministry of Personnel for assignment—up to ten thousand men—Linpu assigned posts according to talent, and all regarded it as fitting; commentators compared him to Gao Xiaoji of Sui.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was first settled, prefectures, districts, and imperial envoys had appointed officials by red slip; that practice was now abolished and all candidates were gathered under the ministry of personnel for assignment—nearly ten thousand in all. Linpu assigned posts according to talent, and the measure was universally applauded; commentators compared him to Gao Xiaoji of the Sui.

sentences.zh: 祥道少襲爵，曆御史中丞。

translations.literal: Xiangdao in youth inherited the title, and served as Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangdao inherited his father's title while still young and served as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 顯慶中，遷吏部黃門侍郎，知選事。

translations.literal: In the Xianqing era he was transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel and of the Yellow Gate, and handled selection affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianqing era he was promoted to vice director of the ministries of personnel and of the yellow gate, with charge of official selection.

sentences.zh: 既世職，乃厘補敝闕，上疏陳六事：

translations.literal: Since it was a hereditary office, he then rectified and repaired deficiencies, and submitted a memorial setting forth six matters:
translations.idiomatic: Holding what had become a family specialty in office, he set about correcting longstanding abuses and submitted a memorial proposing six reforms:

sentences.zh: 一曰：今取士多且濫。

translations.literal: First: today recruitment of officials is both excessive and indiscriminate.
translations.idiomatic: First: the recruitment of officials today is both excessive and indiscriminate.

sentences.zh: 入流歲千四百，多也；

translations.literal: Those entering the ranks each year number fourteen hundred—that is excessive;
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen hundred men enter the ranks each year—that is too many;

sentences.zh: 雜色入流，未始銓汰，濫也。

translations.literal: miscellaneous categories entering the ranks have never been screened and culled—that is indiscriminate.
translations.idiomatic: and candidates from miscellaneous categories have never been screened and culled—that is indiscriminate.

sentences.zh: 故共務者，善人少，惡人多。

translations.literal: Therefore among those who share public business, the good are few and the bad are many.
translations.idiomatic: As a result, among those who share in public business the good are few and the bad are many.

sentences.zh: 臣謂應雜色進者，切責有司試判為四等，第一付吏部，二付兵部，三付主爵，四付司勳。

translations.literal: Your subject holds that those advancing from miscellaneous categories should be strictly required by the responsible offices to take judgment examinations graded in four classes: first class to the Ministry of Personnel, second to the Ministry of War, third to the Directorate of Honorary Titles, fourth to the Directorate of Meritorious Service.
translations.idiomatic: I propose that candidates advancing from miscellaneous categories be rigorously examined by the responsible offices in judgment essays graded in four classes: first class to the ministry of personnel, second to the ministry of war, third to the directorate of honorary titles, and fourth to the directorate of meritorious service.

sentences.zh: 若坐負當責，雖經赦，仍配三司，不者還本貫，則官不雜矣。

translations.literal: If guilty of debt and liable to punishment, even though pardoned, they should still be assigned to the Three Directorates; otherwise they should return to their native place—then offices would not be mixed.
translations.idiomatic: If a candidate is guilty of debt or other punishable offense, even after amnesty he should be assigned to one of the three directorates; otherwise he should be sent back to his native place. Then offices would no longer be filled indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 二曰：內外官，一品至九品萬三千四百六十五員。

translations.literal: Second: civil and military offices from first to ninth rank total thirteen thousand four hundred sixty-five posts.
translations.idiomatic: Second: civil and military offices from first to ninth rank total 13,465 posts.

sentences.zh: 大抵三十而仕，六十而退，取其中數，不三十年，存者略盡。

translations.literal: Broadly speaking, one enters service at thirty and retires at sixty; taking the middle figure, within less than thirty years those remaining are nearly all gone.
translations.idiomatic: Broadly speaking, men enter service at thirty and retire at sixty; taking the midpoint, within less than thirty years nearly all incumbents will have departed.

sentences.zh: 若歲入流五百人，則三十年自相充補。

translations.literal: If five hundred enter the ranks each year, then in thirty years they would naturally fill the vacancies themselves.
translations.idiomatic: If five hundred men entered the ranks each year, within thirty years they would naturally replenish the vacancies.

sentences.zh: 況三十年外，在官猶多，不慮其少。

translations.literal: Moreover, beyond thirty years many still hold office—there is no need to worry that they are too few.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, many officials remain in office beyond thirty years; there is no need to fear a shortage of personnel.

sentences.zh: 今入流歲千四百，其倍兩之，又停選六七千人，復年別新加，其類浸廣，殆非經久之制。

translations.literal: Today fourteen hundred enter the ranks each year—more than double that; moreover six or seven thousand suspended selections accumulate, and each year new additions are made—the category grows ever wider; this is scarcely a system for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: Today fourteen hundred enter the ranks each year—more than double the sustainable rate; six or seven thousand suspended selections have piled up, and new candidates are added every year. The pool grows ever wider, and this is scarcely a system built to last.

sentences.zh: 古者為官擇人，不聞取人多而官少也。

translations.literal: In antiquity offices chose men; one never heard of choosing many men for few offices.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity offices chose the right men; one never heard of choosing ever more men for ever fewer offices.

sentences.zh: 三曰：永徽以來，在官者或以善政擢，論事者或以單言進，而庠序諸生未聞甄異，是獎勸之道未周也。

translations.literal: Third: since Yonghui, incumbents have sometimes been promoted for good governance, and memorialists sometimes advanced on a single statement—yet students of the schools have not been heard of receiving special selection; the way of reward and encouragement is incomplete.
translations.idiomatic: Third: since the Yonghui era, incumbents have sometimes been promoted for good governance and memorialists have sometimes advanced on the strength of a single statement—yet students in the state schools have never been singled out for distinction. The path of reward and encouragement remains incomplete.

sentences.zh: 四曰：唐有天下四十年，未有舉秀才者，請自六品以下至草野，審加搜訪，無令赫赫之辰，斯學遂絕。

translations.literal: Fourth: in the forty years since Tang possessed the realm, no one has been recommended as cultivated talent; I ask that from sixth rank and below down to the common fields a careful search be made, lest in this glorious age that learning should perish.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: in the forty years since the Tang won the realm, not one candidate has been recommended as cultivated talent. I ask that from sixth rank and below down to the common fields a careful search be conducted, lest in this glorious age that tradition of learning should die out.

sentences.zh: 五曰：唐、虞三載考績，黜陟幽明。

translations.literal: Fifth: in the eras of Tang and Yu, merit was examined every three years and the obscure and the clear were demoted and promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth: in the eras of Tang and Yu, merit was reviewed every three years and the obscure and the clear were demoted and promoted alike.

sentences.zh: 二漢用人，亦久其職。

translations.literal: The two Han dynasties too, in employing men, kept them long in their posts.
translations.idiomatic: The two Han dynasties, too, kept men long in their posts when employing them.

sentences.zh: 今任官率四考罷，官知秩滿，則懷去就；

translations.literal: Today officials generally serve four evaluations and then leave; once they know their term is full, they harbor thoughts of departure;
translations.idiomatic: Today officials generally serve four evaluations and then depart; once they know their term is ending, they turn their minds to leaving;

sentences.zh: 民知遷徙，則苟且。

translations.literal: once the people know their officials will be transferred, they become careless.
translations.idiomatic: and once the people know their magistrates will be transferred, they grow careless.

sentences.zh: 以去就之官，臨苟且之民，欲移風振俗，烏可得乎？

translations.literal: With officials minded to leave governing a people grown careless, how can customs be changed and morals revived?
translations.idiomatic: How can customs be changed and morals revived when officials already thinking of departure govern a people grown careless?

sentences.zh: 請四考進階，八考聽選，以息迎新送故之弊。

translations.literal: I ask that advancement come after four evaluations and eligibility for reassignment after eight, to end the abuses of welcoming newcomers and seeing off departures.
translations.idiomatic: I propose that promotion come after four evaluations and eligibility for reassignment after eight, so as to end the abuses of constantly welcoming newcomers and seeing off departures.

sentences.zh: 六曰：三省都事、主事、主書，比選補，皆取流外有刀筆者，雖欲參用士流，率以儔類為恥。

translations.literal: Sixth: the chief clerks, section heads, and recorders of the Three Departments, when selected and appointed, are all taken from outside the regular stream for those skilled with the pen; even when one wishes to employ men of the regular stream, they are generally ashamed to be classed with such company.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth: the chief clerks, section heads, and recorders of the three departments are all drawn from outside the regular recruitment stream for their clerical skill; even when one wishes to employ men of the regular stream, they are generally ashamed to be grouped with such company.

sentences.zh: 前後相沿，遂成故事。

translations.literal: Passed down from predecessor to successor, this has become fixed practice.
translations.idiomatic: Handed down from one generation to the next, this has become fixed practice.

sentences.zh: 且掖省崇峻，王言秘密，尚書政本，人物所歸，專責曹史，理有未盡，宜稍革之，以清其選。

translations.literal: Moreover the Secretariat is lofty, imperial words are secret, and the Ministry of Personnel is the root of government and the object of men's aspirations—yet to entrust it wholly to clerks is in principle incomplete; it should be somewhat reformed to clarify selection.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat is lofty and imperial words are secret; the ministry of personnel is the root of government and the object of every man's ambition—yet to entrust it wholly to clerks is fundamentally unsound. This should be reformed to restore clarity to selection.

sentences.zh: 會中書令杜正倫亦言入流者眾，為官人敝，乃詔與祥道參議，而執政憚改作，又以勳戚子進取無他門，遂格。

translations.literal: At the time the Secretariat Director Du Zhenglun also said that those entering the ranks were numerous and that this harmed officials; an edict was issued for joint deliberation with Xiangdao, but the chief ministers feared reform, and because sons of meritorious clans had no other path to advancement, the proposal was tabled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the secretariat director Du Zhenglun also argued that too many men were entering the ranks and that this harmed the quality of officialdom. An edict ordered joint deliberation with Xiangdao, but the chief ministers feared reform, and because sons of meritorious clans had no other path to advancement, the proposal was tabled.

sentences.zh: 子 齊賢

translations.literal: Son: Qixian
translations.idiomatic: Son: Qixian

sentences.zh: 齊賢三世至兩省侍郎，典選。

translations.literal: Qixian for three generations reached Vice Director of the Two Departments and handled selection.
translations.idiomatic: For three generations Qixian's line reached vice director of the two departments and handled official selection.

sentences.zh: 從父應道吏部郎中，從父弟令植禮部侍郎，凡八人前後曆吏部郎中、員外，世以為罕。

translations.literal: His father's younger brother Yingdao was Director in the Ministry of Personnel; his father's younger brother's son Lingzhi was Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites; eight men in all successively served as Director or Vice Director in the Ministry of Personnel—a thing the age regarded as rare.
translations.idiomatic: His father's younger brother Yingdao served as director in the ministry of personnel; his cousin Lingzhi served as vice director of the ministry of rites. Eight men in all successively held directorships or vice directorships in the ministry of personnel—a thing the age regarded as rare.

sentences.zh: 令植孫從一，擢進士宏詞第，調渭南尉。

translations.literal: Lingzhi's grandson Congyi passed the jinshi and hongci examinations, and was appointed magistrate of Weinan.
translations.idiomatic: Lingzhi's grandson Congyi passed the jinshi and hongci examinations and was appointed magistrate of Weinan.

sentences.zh: 雅為常袞、盧杞所厚，薦授監察御史。

translations.literal: He was greatly favored by Chang Gun and Lu Qi, who recommended him and had him appointed investigating censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Gun and Lu Qi favored him greatly, recommended him, and had him appointed investigating censor.

sentences.zh: 普王討李希烈，表為元帥判官。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Pu campaigned against Li Xilie, he was listed on the marshal's staff as judge.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince of Pu campaigned against Li Xilie, Congyi served on the marshal's staff as judge.

sentences.zh: 德宗居奉天，超拜刑部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: When Dezong was at Fengtian, he was promoted by special order to Vice Director of the Ministry of Justice and Grand Counselor of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong was besieged at Fengtian, Congyi was promoted by special order to vice director of the ministry of justice and grand counselor of the secretariat and chancellery.

sentences.zh: 從幸梁州，改中書侍郎，帝遇之善。

translations.literal: He followed the Emperor to Liangzhou and was changed to Vice Director of the Secretariat; the Emperor treated him well.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the emperor to Liangzhou and was transferred to vice director of the secretariat; the emperor treated him with favor.

sentences.zh: 然無它材能，容身遠罪而已。

translations.literal: Yet he had no other talent—he merely kept himself safe and kept clear of blame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he possessed no other talent; he merely kept himself safe and clear of blame.

sentences.zh: 貞元初，以疾自乞，罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenyuan era, citing illness he requested leave and was dismissed to serve as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenyuan era he cited illness, requested leave, and was dismissed to serve as minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太傅。

translations.literal: On his death he was posthumously appointed Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On his death he was posthumously appointed grand tutor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 李敬玄

translations.literal: Li Jingxuan
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxuan

sentences.zh: 李敬玄，亳州譙人。

translations.literal: Li Jingxuan was a man of Qiao in Bo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingxuan was a native of Qiao in Bo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 該覽群籍，尤善於禮。

translations.literal: He mastered many texts and was especially skilled in ritual.
translations.idiomatic: He mastered a wide range of texts and was especially skilled in ritual.

sentences.zh: 高宗在東宮，馬周薦其材，召入崇賢館侍讀，假中秘書讀之。

translations.literal: When Gaozong was Eastern Heir, Ma Zhou recommended his talent; he was summoned into the Chongxian Hall as lecturer-in-attendance and lent the imperial library to read.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gaozong was eastern heir, Ma Zhou recommended his talent; he was summoned to the Chongxian Hall as lecturer-in-attendance and granted access to the imperial library.

sentences.zh: 為人峻整，然造請不憚寒暑。

translations.literal: As a man he was stern and orderly, yet in paying calls he did not shrink from cold or heat.
translations.idiomatic: He was stern and orderly in manner, yet when paying calls he did not shrink from cold or heat.

sentences.zh: 許敬宗頗薦延之。

translations.literal: Xu Jingzong often recommended and extended him.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Jingzong often recommended and promoted him.

sentences.zh: 曆西台舍人，弘文館學士。

translations.literal: He successively served as Secretariat Draftsman and Academician of the Hongwen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as secretariat draftsman and academician of the Hongwen Hall.

sentences.zh: 遷右肅機，檢校太子右中護。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Right Censor-in-Chief and made acting Right Supervisor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to right censor-in-chief and made acting right supervisor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 拜西台侍郎、同東西台三品，兼檢校司列少常伯。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Director of the Western Terrace, Third Rank of the Two Terraces, and concurrently acting Vice Director of the Directorate of Court Music.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed vice director of the western terrace, third rank of the two terraces, and concurrently acting vice director of the directorate of court music.

sentences.zh: 時員外郎張仁禕有敏才，敬玄委以曹事，仁禕為造姓曆、狀式、銓簿，鉗鍵周密，病心太勞死。

translations.literal: At the time the Vice Director Zhang Renyi had keen talent; Jingxuan entrusted him with bureau affairs; Renyi devised surname registers, format templates, and selection ledgers—tight and thorough in every lock—then died of overwork from heart strain.
translations.idiomatic: At the time vice director Zhang Renyi was a man of keen talent; Jingxuan entrusted him with bureau affairs. Renyi devised surname registers, format templates, and selection ledgers, tight and thorough in every detail, then died of heart strain brought on by overwork.

sentences.zh: 敬玄因其法，衡綜有序。

translations.literal: Jingxuan followed his methods, and weighing and ordering became systematic.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan adopted his methods, and weighing and ordering candidates became systematic.

sentences.zh: 自永徽後，選員浸多，惟敬玄居職有能稱。

translations.literal: Since Yonghui the number of selection candidates had gradually increased; only Jingxuan in holding the post was regarded as capable.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Yonghui era the number of selection candidates had steadily increased; only Jingxuan, in holding the post, was regarded as capable.

sentences.zh: 性強記，雖官萬員，遇諸道，未嘗忘姓氏。

translations.literal: By nature he had a strong memory; though officials numbered ten thousand, when he met men from various circuits he never forgot their surnames.
translations.idiomatic: He had a prodigious memory; though officials numbered ten thousand, when he met men from various circuits he never forgot their surnames.

sentences.zh: 有來訴者，口諭書判參舛及殿累本末無少繆，天下伏其明。

translations.literal: When petitioners came, he dictated written judgments on discrepancies and the full sequence of audience demerits without the slightest error; the realm submitted to his clarity.
translations.idiomatic: When petitioners came before him, he dictated written judgments on discrepancies and the full sequence of audience demerits without the slightest error; the realm submitted to his clarity.

sentences.zh: 杭州參軍徐太玄哀其僚張惠以贓抵死，而惠母老，乃詣獄自言與惠偕受，薄其罪，惠得不死，太玄坐免官十年。

translations.literal: Xu Taixuan, a staff officer of Hangzhou, pitying his colleague Zhang Hui, who faced death for corruption though his mother was old, went to the prison and declared that he and Hui had received bribes together, so as to lighten Hui's sentence and save him from death; Taixuan was dismissed from office for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Taixuan, a staff officer of Hangzhou, pitying his colleague Zhang Hui—who faced execution for corruption though his mother was elderly—went to the prison and declared that he and Hui had taken bribes together, so as to lighten Hui's sentence and save him from death. Taixuan was dismissed from office for ten years.

sentences.zh: 敬玄廉知之，擢為鄭州司功參軍，後至秘書少監、申王師，以德行聞。

translations.literal: Jingxuan, knowing of it through investigation, promoted him to Staff Officer of Zhengzhou; later he reached Vice Director of the Secretariat and Tutor to the Prince of Shen, famed for virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan learned of the matter through investigation and promoted him to staff officer of Zhengzhou; later Taixuan rose to vice director of the secretariat and tutor to the prince of Shen, famed for his virtue.

sentences.zh: 其鑒拔率若此。

translations.literal: His discernment and elevation were generally like this.
translations.idiomatic: His discernment and elevation of talent were generally like this.

sentences.zh: 咸亨二年，轉中書侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianheng he was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianheng he was transferred to vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 又改吏部，兼太子右庶子、同中書門下三品，監修國史。

translations.literal: He was again changed to the Ministry of Personnel, concurrently Right Subordinate of the Heir Apparent, Third Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Supervisor of the compilation of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to the ministry of personnel, concurrently right subordinate of the heir apparent, third rank of the secretariat and chancellery, and supervisor of the compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 進吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of personnel.

sentences.zh: 居選部久，人多附向。

translations.literal: Having long held the Selection Bureau, many men attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: Having long held the selection bureau, many men attached themselves to him.

sentences.zh: 凡三娶皆山東舊族，又與趙李氏合譜，故台省要職多族屬姻家。

translations.literal: All three of his marriages were to old clans of Shandong, and he also merged genealogies with the Zhao and Li families; therefore key posts in the central offices were largely held by clansmen and in-laws.
translations.idiomatic: All three of his marriages were to old clans of Shandong, and he also merged genealogies with the Zhao and Li families; as a result, key posts in the central offices were largely held by clansmen and in-laws.

sentences.zh: 高宗知之，不能善也。

translations.literal: Gaozong knew this and could not regard him favorably.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong knew this and could not regard him favorably.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳元年，拜中書令，封趙國公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yifeng he was appointed Secretariat Director and enfeoffed as Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yifeng he was appointed secretariat director and enfeoffed as duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 劉仁軌西討吐蕃，有所建請，敬玄數持異，由是有隙，因奏河西鎮守非敬玄不可。

translations.literal: When Liu Rengui campaigned west against Tibet and made proposals, Jingxuan repeatedly held differing views; hence a rift arose, and he memorialized that the garrison of the Hexi region could not do without Jingxuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Rengui campaigned west against Tibet and made proposals, Jingxuan repeatedly disagreed; a rift arose, and Rengui memorialized that the Hexi garrison could not do without Jingxuan.

sentences.zh: 敬玄辭以非將帥才，且仁軌逞憾，故強臣以不能。

translations.literal: Jingxuan declined on the grounds that he lacked talent as a general, and moreover that Rengui was venting resentment—therefore a powerful minister forced one who could not serve.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan declined on the grounds that he lacked talent as a general and that Rengui was venting personal resentment—thus a powerful minister was forced upon a man unfit for command.

sentences.zh: 帝厭之，因曰：「仁軌若須朕，朕且行，卿安得辭？」

translations.literal: The Emperor grew weary of it and therefore said: "If Rengui needs Us, We shall go in person—how can you decline?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor grew weary of the dispute and said, "If Rengui needs me, I shall go in person—how can you decline?"

sentences.zh: 乃拜洮河道大總管，兼鎮撫大使，檢校鄯州都督，統兵十八萬，代仁軌。

translations.literal: He was then appointed Grand Commander of the Taohe Circuit, concurrently Pacification Commissioner, acting Area Commander of Shan Prefecture, commanding one hundred eighty thousand troops, replacing Rengui.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan was then appointed grand commander of the Taohe Circuit, concurrently pacification commissioner and acting area commander of Shan Prefecture, commanding 180,000 troops in Rengui's place.

sentences.zh: 與吐蕃將論欽陵戰青海，使劉審禮為先鋒，麈虜，敬玄按軍自如，審禮戰歿，尚首鼠不進，乃頓承風嶺，又陰溝淖，莫能前，賊屯高壓其營。

translations.literal: He fought the Tibetan general Lun Qinling at Qinghai, with Liu Shenli as vanguard; he routed the enemy, and Jingxuan held the army steady as before—Shenli died in battle; yet Jingxuan remained irresolute and would not advance, halting at Chengfeng Ridge and again at Yingounao, unable to go forward, while the bandits camped on high and pressed down on his encampment.
translations.idiomatic: He fought the Tibetan general Lun Qinling at Qinghai with Liu Shenli as vanguard. The vanguard routed the enemy while Jingxuan held the main army steady—but when Shenli fell in battle, Jingxuan remained irresolute and would not advance. He halted at Chengfeng Ridge and again at Yingounao, unable to move forward while the enemy camped on the heights above his encampment.

sentences.zh: 偏將黑齒常之率死士夜擊賊，敬玄始得至鄯州。

translations.literal: The deputy general Heichi Changzhi led daredevils in a night attack on the bandits, and only then did Jingxuan reach Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The deputy general Heichi Changzhi led daredevils in a night attack on the enemy, and only then did Jingxuan reach Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又戰湟川，遂大敗。

translations.literal: He fought again at Huangchuan and suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He fought again at Huangchuan and suffered a crushing defeat.

sentences.zh: 數稱疾求罷歸，許之。

translations.literal: Repeatedly citing illness he requested recall and dismissal; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly cited illness and requested recall; his request was granted.

sentences.zh: 既入見，不引謝，即還府視事。

translations.literal: Once he had entered audience he offered no apology, but returned straight to his office and resumed business.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to court he offered no apology, but went straight back to his office and resumed business.

sentences.zh: 帝察實不病，貶衡州刺史。

translations.literal: The Emperor perceived that he was not in fact ill and demoted him to Prefect of Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor saw that he was not in fact ill and demoted him to prefect of Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 久之，遷揚州長史。

translations.literal: After a long while he was transferred to Chief Administrator of Yang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he was transferred to chief administrator of Yang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 卒官，贈兗州都督，諡曰文憲。

translations.literal: He died in office; posthumously appointed Area Commander of Yan Prefecture; posthumous name Wenzian.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office and was posthumously appointed area commander of Yan Prefecture; his posthumous name was Wenzian.

sentences.zh: 撰次《禮論》及它書數十百篇。

translations.literal: He compiled the Discourse on Ritual and several dozen other works, totaling hundreds of chapters.
translations.idiomatic: He compiled the Discourse on Ritual and several dozen other works totaling hundreds of chapters.

sentences.zh: 二子：思沖、守一。

translations.literal: Two sons: Sichong and Shouyi.
translations.idiomatic: Two sons: Sichong and Shouyi.

sentences.zh: 思沖，神龍初，曆工部侍郎、左羽林軍將軍，從節湣太子誅武三思，見殺，籍其家。

translations.literal: Sichong, at the beginning of Shenlong, successively served as Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and General of the Left Feathered Forest Army; he followed the Crown Prince Jiemin in executing Wu Sansi and was killed; his household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Sichong, at the beginning of the Shenlong era, served in turn as vice director of the ministry of works and general of the left feathered forest army. He followed Crown Prince Jiemin in executing Wu Sansi and was killed; his household was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 守一郫令。

translations.literal: Shouyi was magistrate of Pi.
translations.idiomatic: Shouyi served as magistrate of Pi.

sentences.zh: 孫紳別傳。

translations.literal: Sun Shen has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Shen has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 弟 元素

translations.literal: Younger brother: Yuansu
translations.idiomatic: Younger brother: Yuansu

sentences.zh: 敬玄弟元素，為武德令。

translations.literal: Jingxuan's younger brother Yuansu was magistrate of Wude.
translations.idiomatic: Jingxuan's younger brother Yuansu served as magistrate of Wude.

sentences.zh: 刺史李文暕橫調民黃金造常滿尊以獻，官屬無敢諫，元素固爭，文暕為少損，更以私財助之。

translations.literal: The prefect Li Wenliang forcibly levied the people's gold to cast an ever-full goblet as tribute; none of the staff dared remonstrate; Yuansu firmly argued against it; Wenliang slightly reduced the levy and further supplied the cost from private funds.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect Li Wenliang forcibly levied gold from the people to cast an ever-full goblet as tribute; none of the staff dared remonstrate. Yuansu argued against it firmly; Wenliang slightly reduced the levy and further supplied part of the cost from his private funds.

sentences.zh: 延載初，繇文昌左丞遷鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞台平章事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yanzai he rose from Left Assistant Director of the Wenchang Directorate to Vice Director of the Fengge and Grand Counselor of the Fengge and Luantai.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yanzai era he rose from left assistant director of the Wenchang directorate to vice director of the Fengge and grand counselor of the Fengge and Luantai.

sentences.zh: 為武懿宗所構，與綦連耀等同誅。

translations.literal: He was framed by Wu Yizong and was executed together with Qi Lianyao and others.
translations.idiomatic: He was framed by Wu Yizong and was executed together with Qi Lianyao and others.

sentences.zh: 神龍中，追洗其辜。

translations.literal: In the Shenlong era his guilt was posthumously cleared.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shenlong era his guilt was posthumously cleared.

sentences.zh: 劉德威

translations.literal: Liu Dewei
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dewei

sentences.zh: 劉德威，徐州彭城人。

translations.literal: Liu Dewei was a man of Pengcheng in Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dewei was a native of Pengcheng in Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 姿貌魁秀，有幹略。

translations.literal: In bearing he was tall and handsome, with capacity and strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Tall and handsome in bearing, he possessed capacity and strategic skill.

sentences.zh: 隋大業末，從裴仁基討淮賊，手劍賊酋，傳行在。

translations.literal: At the end of Daye in Sui he followed Pei Renji in campaigning against Huai bandits, personally sworded the bandit chieftain, and sent the head to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Sui Daye era he followed Pei Renji in campaigning against Huai bandits, personally ran the bandit chieftain through with his sword, and sent the head to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 後歸李密，密分麾下兵使守懷州。

translations.literal: Later he submitted to Li Mi; Mi divided troops under his command to guard Huai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he submitted to Li Mi, who assigned troops under his command to guard Huai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 密降，俱入朝，授左武候將軍，封滕縣公。

translations.literal: When Mi surrendered, both entered court; he was appointed General of the Left Martial Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Teng County.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Mi surrendered, both entered court together; Dewei was appointed general of the left martial guard and enfeoffed as duke of Teng County.

sentences.zh: 詔將兵擊劉武周，因判并州總管府司馬。

translations.literal: By edict he led troops to attack Liu Wuzhou and concurrently served as aide to the Bingzhou Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: By edict he led troops against Liu Wuzhou and concurrently served as aide to the Bingzhou area command.

sentences.zh: 裴寂失律，齊王元吉棄州遁，德威總留府事。

translations.literal: Pei Ji violated military discipline; Prince Qi Yuanji abandoned the prefecture and fled; Dewei took overall charge of the prefectural headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Ji violated military discipline and Prince Qi Yuanji abandoned the prefecture and fled, Dewei took overall charge of the prefectural headquarters.

sentences.zh: 賊薄城，民皆叛附賊，遂為武周所獲，使率本部徇地浩州，得自拔歸，盡上賊中虛實，高祖嘉納，改彭城縣公。

translations.literal: When the rebels pressed the city, the people all defected to join them; Dewei was then captured by Wu Zhou, who had him lead his own command to sweep through Haozhou; he managed to escape and return, reported fully on conditions within the rebel camp, Gaozu praised and accepted this, and changed his enfeoffment to Duke of Pengcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels pressed the city, the people all defected to join them; Dewei was then captured by Wu Zhou, who had him lead his own command to sweep through Haozhou; he managed to escape and return, reported fully on conditions within the rebel camp, Gaozu praised and accepted this, and changed his enfeoffment to duke of Pengcheng County.

sentences.zh: 未幾，檢校大理少卿，從平洛陽，有功，轉刑部侍郎，加散騎常侍，妻以平壽縣主。

translations.literal: Before long he served as acting Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review; he followed the campaign to pacify Luoyang, performed meritorious service, was transferred to Vice Minister of Justice, was given the additional title of Regular Attendant, and was given a princess of Ping Shou County in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he served as acting vice director of the court of judicial review; he followed the campaign to pacify Luoyang, performed meritorious service, was transferred to vice minister of justice, was given the additional title of regular attendant, and was given a princess of Ping Shou County in marriage.

sentences.zh: 貞觀初，曆大理卿、綿州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenguan era he successively served as Director of the Court of Judicial Review and prefect of Mian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenguan era he successively served as director of the court of judicial review and prefect of Mian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 政號廉平，百姓立石頌德。

translations.literal: His governance was known for integrity and fairness, and the people erected a stone monument to praise his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: His governance was known for integrity and fairness, and the people erected a stone monument to praise his virtue.

sentences.zh: 尋檢校益州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he served as acting chief administrator of the Grand Area Command of Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he served as acting chief administrator of the grand area command of Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 入為大理卿。

translations.literal: He entered the capital and became Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital and became director of the court of judicial review.

sentences.zh: 太宗問曰：「比刑網浸密，咎安在？」

translations.literal: Taizong asked, "Recently the penal net has grown ever tighter—where does the blame lie?
translations.idiomatic: Taizong asked, "Recently the penal net has grown ever tighter—where does the blame lie?

sentences.zh: 德威曰：「在君不在臣。

translations.literal: Dewei said, "It lies with the ruler, not with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Dewei said, "It lies with the ruler, not with the ministers.

sentences.zh: 下之寬猛，視主之好。

translations.literal: Whether subordinates are lenient or severe depends on what the ruler favors.
translations.idiomatic: Whether subordinates are lenient or severe depends on what the ruler favors.

sentences.zh: 律：失入者減三，失出者減五。

translations.literal: The law: for wrongful conviction the penalty is reduced by three degrees; for wrongful acquittal it is reduced by five degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The law: for wrongful conviction the penalty is reduced by three degrees; for wrongful acquittal it is reduced by five degrees.

sentences.zh: 今坐入者無辜，坐出者有罪，所以吏務深文，為自營計，非有教使然也。」

translations.literal: Now those convicted of excessive severity are held innocent, while those convicted of excessive leniency are held guilty; therefore officials pursue harsh wording for their own advantage—it is not that instruction makes them do so."
translations.idiomatic: Now those convicted of excessive severity are held innocent, while those convicted of excessive leniency are held guilty; therefore officials pursue harsh wording for their own advantage—it is not that instruction makes them do so."

sentences.zh: 帝然其言。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words.

sentences.zh: 後遷刑部尚書，檢校雍州別駕。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Minister of Justice and served as acting Vice Prefect of Yong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was transferred to minister of justice and served as acting vice prefect of Yong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔至齊州按齊王祐獄，還，半道聞祐反，入據濟州。

translations.literal: He was ordered to Qi Prefecture to investigate the case of Prince of Qi You; on his return, halfway there he heard that You had rebelled and had entered and seized Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to Qi Prefecture to investigate the case of Prince of Qi You; on his return, halfway there he heard that You had rebelled and had entered and seized Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔德威就發河南兵經略之，會母喪免。

translations.literal: Dewei was ordered to mobilize Henan troops to suppress the rebellion, but on encountering his mother's death he was relieved of duty.
translations.idiomatic: Dewei was ordered to mobilize Henan troops to suppress the rebellion, but on encountering his mother's death he was relieved of duty.

sentences.zh: 既除，為同州刺史。

translations.literal: After the mourning period ended, he became prefect of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After the mourning period ended, he became prefect of Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永徽三年，卒官，年七十一，贈禮部尚書、幽州都督，諡曰襄，陪葬獻陵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yonghui he died in office at the age of seventy-one; he was posthumously appointed Minister of Rites and Area Commander of You Prefecture; his posthumous name was Xiang; and he was buried near Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yonghui he died in office at the age of seventy-one; he was posthumously appointed minister of rites and area commander of You Prefecture; his posthumous name was Xiang; and he was buried near Xianling.

sentences.zh: 德威于閨門友睦，為人寬平，生平所得奉祿，以分宗親，無留藏。

translations.literal: Within his household Dewei was friendly and harmonious; as a man he was generous and even-tempered; the salary he received in his lifetime he divided among his kinsmen, keeping nothing in reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Within his household Dewei was friendly and harmonious; as a man he was generous and even-tempered; the salary he received in his lifetime he divided among his kinsmen, keeping nothing in reserve.

sentences.zh: 子審禮。

translations.literal: His son was Shenli.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Shenli.

sentences.zh: 子 審禮

translations.literal: Son: Shenli
translations.idiomatic: Son: Shenli

sentences.zh: 審禮少喪母，為祖母元所養。

translations.literal: Shenli lost his mother while young and was raised by his grandmother, Lady Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Shenli lost his mother while young and was raised by his grandmother, Lady Yuan.

sentences.zh: 隋末大亂，道不通，審禮尚少，自鄉里負祖母度江，轉側避地。

translations.literal: At the end of the Sui the realm fell into great disorder and roads were cut off; Shenli was still young, yet he carried his grandmother on his back across the Yangzi and wandered from place to place seeking refuge.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Sui the realm fell into great disorder and roads were cut off; Shenli was still young, yet he carried his grandmother on his back across the Yangzi and wandered from place to place seeking refuge.

sentences.zh: 及天下平，西入長安。

translations.literal: When the realm was pacified, they went west and entered Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: When the realm was pacified, they went west and entered Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 元每疾病，必親煮藥，嘗而進。

translations.literal: Whenever Yuan fell ill, he always personally brewed medicine, tasted it, and then presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Yuan fell ill, he always personally brewed medicine, tasted it, and then presented it.

sentences.zh: 元曰：「兒孝通幽顯，吾一顧念，疾輒間。」

translations.literal: Yuan said, "The boy's filial piety reaches both the living and the dead; whenever I turn my thoughts to him, my illness eases.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said, "The boy's filial piety reaches both the living and the dead; whenever I turn my thoughts to him, my illness eases.

sentences.zh: 貞觀中，曆左驍衛郎將。

translations.literal: During the Zhenguan era he successively served as Commandant of the Left Xiaowei Guard.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenguan era he successively served as commandant of the Left Xiaowei Guard.

sentences.zh: 父喪免。

translations.literal: On his father's death he left office.
translations.idiomatic: On his father's death he left office.

sentences.zh: 比葬，徙跣血流，行路咨歎。

translations.literal: By the time of the burial he had walked barefoot until his feet bled; travelers on the road sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of the burial he had walked barefoot until his feet bled; travelers on the road sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 服除，當襲爵，讓其弟，不聽。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was due to inherit the title, but he yielded it to his younger brother; the court would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was due to inherit the title, but he yielded it to his younger brother; the court would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 見父執必感泗滂沱。

translations.literal: Whenever he met his father's old associates he was moved to tears streaming down his face.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he met his father's old associates he was moved to tears streaming down his face.

sentences.zh: 事繼母尤謹，與弟延景為聞友，得祿多資之，而妻子執寒苦，晏如也。

translations.literal: He was especially careful in serving his stepmother; he and his younger brother Yanjing were friends as neighbors; when he received salary he largely supported Yanjing, while his own wife and children endured cold and hardship yet remained perfectly content.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially careful in serving his stepmother; he and his younger brother Yanjing were friends as neighbors; when he received salary he largely supported Yanjing, while his own wife and children endured cold and hardship yet remained perfectly content.

sentences.zh: 再從皆同居，合二百口，內外無間言。

translations.literal: All his cousins of the second remove lived together under one roof, two hundred mouths in all, and within and without the household there was not a word of discord.
translations.idiomatic: All his cousins of the second remove lived together under one roof, two hundred mouths in all, and within and without the household there was not a word of discord.

sentences.zh: 遷工部尚書，檢校左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Works and served as acting Grand General of the Left Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to minister of works and served as acting grand general of the left guard.

sentences.zh: 儀鳳三年，吐番寇涼州，副中書令李敬玄討之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yifeng the Tibetans raided Liang Prefecture; he served as deputy to Chief Minister Li Jingxuan in the campaign against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yifeng the Tibetans raided Liang Prefecture; he served as deputy to chief minister Li Jingxuan in the campaign against them.

sentences.zh: 遇虜青海上，與戰，敬玄逗撓不前，審禮敗，為虜執。

translations.literal: They encountered the enemy on Qinghai and fought; Jingxuan hesitated and would not advance; Shenli was defeated and taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: They encountered the enemy on Qinghai and fought; Jingxuan hesitated and would not advance; Shenli was defeated and taken captive.

sentences.zh: 其子尚乘直長殆庶及延景詣闕待罪，請入賊以贖。

translations.literal: His son Shang, Director of the Palace Stud's Straight Office Daishu, and Yanjing went to court to await punishment and requested to enter enemy territory to ransom him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shang, director of the palace stud's straight office Daishu, and Yanjing went to court to await punishment and requested to enter enemy territory to ransom him.

sentences.zh: 有詔審禮徇忠以沒，非有罪，宜各還職。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Shenli had died in loyal service and was not guilty; they should each return to their posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that Shenli had died in loyal service and was not guilty; they should each return to their posts.

sentences.zh: 特詔殆庶弟易從省之。

translations.literal: A special edict granted Daishu's younger brother Yicong leave to go.
translations.idiomatic: A special edict granted Daishu's younger brother Yicong leave to go.

sentences.zh: 既至，而審禮卒，易從晝夜哭不止，吐番哀其志，乃還父屍，徙跣萬里，扶護以歸，見者流涕。

translations.literal: When he arrived, Shenli had already died; Yicong wept day and night without cease; the Tibetans were moved by his resolve, returned his father's corpse, and he walked barefoot ten thousand li, supporting and escorting the body home; all who saw it wept.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, Shenli had already died; Yicong wept day and night without cease; the Tibetans were moved by his resolve, returned his father's corpse, and he walked barefoot ten thousand li, supporting and escorting the body home; all who saw it wept.

sentences.zh: 審禮贈工部尚書，諡曰僖。

translations.literal: Shenli was posthumously appointed Minister of Works; his posthumous name was Xi.
translations.idiomatic: Shenli was posthumously appointed minister of works; his posthumous name was Xi.

sentences.zh: 子 延景

translations.literal: Son: Yanjing
translations.idiomatic: Son: Yanjing

sentences.zh: 延景，字冬日，終陝州刺史。

translations.literal: Yanjing, courtesy name Dongri, ended as prefect of Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yanjing, courtesy name Dongri, ended as prefect of Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 睿宗初，以後父追贈尚書右僕射，陪葬乾陵。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ruizong's reign he was posthumously promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs as empress's father and was buried near Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Ruizong's reign he was posthumously promoted to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs as empress's father and was buried near Qianling.

sentences.zh: 子 易從

translations.literal: Son: Yicong
translations.idiomatic: Son: Yicong

sentences.zh: 易從累遷彭州長史、任城縣男。

translations.literal: Yicong rose through successive appointments to chief administrator of Peng Prefecture and Baron of Rencheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Yicong rose through successive appointments to chief administrator of Peng Prefecture and baron of Rencheng County.

sentences.zh: 永昌中，為酷吏周興誣構，坐死。

translations.literal: During the Yongchang era he was framed by the cruel official Zhou Xing and executed for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongchang era he was framed by the cruel official Zhou Xing and executed for the offense.

sentences.zh: 將刑，百姓奔走，爭解衣投地，曰：「為長史祈福。」

translations.literal: As execution approached, the people ran about, competing to take off their garments and cast them on the ground, saying, "We offer this to pray blessings for the chief administrator.
translations.idiomatic: As execution approached, the people ran about, competing to take off their garments and cast them on the ground, saying, "We offer this to pray blessings for the chief administrator.

sentences.zh: 有司平直，乃十余萬。

translations.literal: When officials measured them flat, there were more than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: When officials measured them flat, there were more than a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 當時號「孝義劉家」。

translations.literal: At the time they were called "the Liu family of filial piety and righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: At the time they were called "the Liu family of filial piety and righteousness."

sentences.zh: 及易從以非禍死，天下冤之。

translations.literal: When Yicong died an undeserved death, the realm regarded it as a grievous injustice.
translations.idiomatic: When Yicong died an undeserved death, the realm regarded it as a grievous injustice.

sentences.zh: 子 昇

translations.literal: Son: Sheng
translations.idiomatic: Son: Sheng

sentences.zh: 子昇，年十餘歲流嶺表，六道使誅流人，升以信愛為首領所庇免。

translations.literal: Zisheng, at little more than ten years of age, was exiled beyond the Ling range; when the commissioners of the six circuits executed exiles, Sheng was spared through the protection of a beloved chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Zisheng, at little more than ten years of age, was exiled beyond the Ling range; when the commissioners of the six circuits executed exiles, Sheng was spared through the protection of a beloved chieftain.

sentences.zh: 後易姓溫，北歸洛。

translations.literal: Later he changed his surname to Wen and returned north to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Later he changed his surname to Wen and returned north to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 景雲中，特授右武衛騎曹參軍。

translations.literal: During the Jingyun era he was specially appointed Cavalry Adjutant of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingyun era he was specially appointed cavalry adjutant of the right martial guard.

sentences.zh: 開元中，累遷中書舍人、太子右庶子。

translations.literal: During the Kaiyuan era he rose through successive appointments to Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat and Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household.
translations.idiomatic: During the Kaiyuan era he rose through successive appointments to drafting secretary of the secretariat and right vice director of the heir apparent's household.

sentences.zh: 昇能文，善草隸。

translations.literal: Sheng was skilled in writing and excelled in cursive and clerical script.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was skilled in writing and excelled in cursive and clerical script.

sentences.zh: 侄 延嗣

translations.literal: Nephew: Yansi
translations.idiomatic: Nephew: Yansi

sentences.zh: 審禮從弟延嗣，為潤州司馬。

translations.literal: Shenli's younger cousin Yansi served as military adjutant of Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shenli's younger cousin Yansi served as military adjutant of Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 徐敬業攻潤州，延嗣與刺史固守。

translations.literal: When Xu Jingye attacked Run Prefecture, Yansi and the prefect defended the city steadfastly.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Jingye attacked Run Prefecture, Yansi and the prefect defended the city steadfastly.

sentences.zh: 俄而城陷，敬業邀以降，延嗣曰：「吾世蒙恩，今城不守，所負多矣，詎能苟生為宗族羞？」

translations.literal: Before long the city fell; Jingye invited him to surrender; Yansi said, "My family has received grace for generations; now that the city is not held, I owe far too much—how could I cling to life and bring shame on my clan?
translations.idiomatic: Before long the city fell; Jingye invited him to surrender; Yansi said, "My family has received grace for generations; now that the city is not held, I owe far too much—how could I cling to life and bring shame on my clan?

sentences.zh: 敬業怒，將斬之，其党魏思溫救止，系江都獄。

translations.literal: Jingye was enraged and was about to execute him; his follower Wei Siwen stopped him, and Yansi was imprisoned in Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Jingye was enraged and was about to execute him; his follower Wei Siwen stopped him, and Yansi was imprisoned in Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 敬業敗，錄忠當敘，以裴炎近親，裁遷梓州長史。

translations.literal: When Jingye was defeated, loyal service was recorded and rewarded; because he was a close kinsman of Pei Yan, he was only transferred to chief administrator of Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingye was defeated, loyal service was recorded and rewarded; because he was a close kinsman of Pei Yan, he was only transferred to chief administrator of Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 轉汾州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Fen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to prefect of Fen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宗族至刺史者二十余人。

translations.literal: More than twenty members of the clan reached the rank of prefect.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty members of the clan reached the rank of prefect.

sentences.zh: 孫處約

translations.literal: Sun Chuyue
translations.idiomatic: Sun Chuyue

sentences.zh: 子 佺

translations.literal: Son: Quan
translations.idiomatic: Son: Quan

sentences.zh: 子佺，延和初，為羽林將軍、幽州都督，率兵十二萬討奚李大酺，分三屯，以副將李楷洛、周以悌領之。

translations.literal: Ziquan, at the beginning of the Yanhe era, served as General of the Feathered Forest and Area Commander of You Prefecture; he led one hundred twenty thousand troops to campaign against the Xi chieftain Li Dapu; he divided into three encampments, with deputy generals Li Kailuo and Zhou Yiti commanding them.
translations.idiomatic: Ziquan, at the beginning of the Yanhe era, served as general of the feathered forest and area commander of You Prefecture; he led one hundred twenty thousand troops to campaign against the Xi chieftain Li Dapu; he divided into three encampments, with deputy generals Li Kailuo and Zhou Yiti commanding them.

sentences.zh: 次冷硎，楷洛與大酺戰，不勝，壯校多沒。

translations.literal: At Lengxing Pass Kailuo fought Dapu, was defeated, and many brave officers were lost.
translations.idiomatic: At Lengxing Pass Kailuo fought Dapu, was defeated, and many brave officers were lost.

sentences.zh: 佺氣褫，乃紿言：「天子詔我招慰奚，楷洛違詔妄戰，當斬。」

translations.literal: Quan's spirit was broken, so he falsely declared, "The Son of Heaven has ordered me to win over and reassure the Xi; Kailuo disobeyed the edict and fought recklessly—he should be executed.
translations.idiomatic: Quan's spirit was broken, so he falsely declared, "The Son of Heaven has ordered me to win over and reassure the Xi; Kailuo disobeyed the edict and fought recklessly—he should be executed.

sentences.zh: 遣人謝大酺。

translations.literal: He sent a messenger to apologize to Dapu.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a messenger to apologize to Dapu.

sentences.zh: 大酺曰：「審爾，願出天子賜，明不欺。」

translations.literal: Dapu said, "If that is truly so, I wish to see the Son of Heaven's gifts, to show there is no deception.
translations.idiomatic: Dapu said, "If that is truly so, I wish to see the Son of Heaven's gifts, to show there is no deception.

sentences.zh: 佺揪聚軍中幣萬餘匹，悉袍、帶並與之。

translations.literal: Quan gathered more than ten thousand bolts of cloth from the army, and gave robes and belts along with them all.
translations.idiomatic: Quan gathered more than ten thousand bolts of cloth from the army, and gave robes and belts along with them all.

sentences.zh: 大酺知佺詐，好語勸引還，而佺部伍離沮，奚逼之，大敗，死者數萬。

translations.literal: Dapu knew Quan was deceiving him, yet spoke kindly and urged him to withdraw; but Quan's ranks were demoralized and scattered, the Xi pressed them, and he suffered a great defeat with tens of thousands dead.
translations.idiomatic: Dapu knew Quan was deceiving him, yet spoke kindly and urged him to withdraw; but Quan's ranks were demoralized and scattered, the Xi pressed them, and he suffered a great defeat with tens of thousands dead.

sentences.zh: 佺、以悌同見獲，送默啜所殺之。

translations.literal: Quan and Yiti were both captured and sent to Moqie's headquarters, where they were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Quan and Yiti were both captured and sent to Moqie's headquarters, where they were killed.

sentences.zh: 刑文偉

translations.literal: Xing Wenwei
translations.idiomatic: Xing Wenwei

sentences.zh: 邢文偉，滁州全椒人。

translations.literal: Xing Wenwei was a native of Quanjiao in Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Wenwei was a native of Quanjiao in Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 與曆陽高子貢、壽春裴懷貴俱以博學聞。

translations.literal: He, Gao Zigong of Liyang, and Pei Huaigui of Shouchun were all known for broad learning.
translations.idiomatic: He, Gao Zigong of Liyang, and Pei Huaigui of Shouchun were all known for broad learning.

sentences.zh: 咸亨中，曆太子典膳丞。

translations.literal: During the Xianheng era he successively served as Director of the Heir Apparent's Office of Provisions.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianheng era he successively served as director of the heir apparent's office of provisions.

sentences.zh: 時孝敬罕見宮臣，文偉即減膳，上書曰：「古者太子既冠，則有司過之史、虧膳之宰。

translations.literal: At the time Xiaojing rarely saw palace officials; Wenwei therefore reduced his provisions and submitted a memorial saying, "In antiquity, once the heir apparent came of age, there were the historiographer who recorded faults and the steward who reduced provisions.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xiaojing rarely saw palace officials; Wenwei therefore reduced his provisions and submitted a memorial saying, "In antiquity, once the heir apparent came of age, there were the historiographer who recorded faults and the steward who reduced provisions.

sentences.zh: 史不書過，死之；

translations.literal: If the historiographer did not record faults, he was put to death;
translations.idiomatic: If the historiographer did not record faults, he was put to death;

sentences.zh: 宰不徹膳，死之。

translations.literal: if the steward did not withdraw provisions, he was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: if the steward did not withdraw provisions, he was put to death.

sentences.zh: 皇帝簡料英俊，自庶子至司議、舍人、學士、侍讀，使佐殿下，成就聖德。

translations.literal: The emperor should select outstanding talents, from vice directors to remonstrance officials, drafting secretaries, academicians, and reading tutors, to assist His Highness and complete his sage virtue.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor should select outstanding talents, from vice directors to remonstrance officials, drafting secretaries, academicians, and reading tutors, to assist His Highness and complete his sage virtue.

sentences.zh: 比者不甚廷議，謁對稀簡，三朝之後，與內人獨居，何繇發揮天資，使浚哲文明哉？

translations.literal: Recently court discussion has been insufficient, audiences have been few and brief, and after the three audiences he dwells alone with inner attendants—how can his natural gifts be brought forth and made wise, perspicacious, and cultivated?
translations.idiomatic: Recently court discussion has been insufficient, audiences have been few and brief, and after the three audiences he dwells alone with inner attendants—how can his natural gifts be brought forth and made wise, perspicacious, and cultivated?

sentences.zh: 今史既闕官，宰得奉職，謹守禮經以聞。」

translations.literal: Now that the historiographer's post is vacant, the steward can perform his duty; I respectfully observe the ritual classics in reporting this.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the historiographer's post is vacant, the steward can perform his duty; I respectfully observe the ritual classics in reporting this.

sentences.zh: 太子答曰：「幼嗜墳典，欲研精極意，而未閑將衛，耽誦致勞。

translations.literal: The heir apparent replied, "From youth I have loved the classics and wished to study them to the utmost depth, yet I am not yet skilled in regulating my health and have exhausted myself in recitation.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent replied, "From youth I have loved the classics and wished to study them to the utmost depth, yet I am not yet skilled in regulating my health and have exhausted myself in recitation.

sentences.zh: 比苦風虛，奉陛下恩旨，不許強勉，加以趨侍朝夕，無自專之道，屢闕坐朝，乖廢學緒。

translations.literal: Recently I have suffered from wind deficiency; following Your Majesty's gracious order I was not permitted to force myself, and in addition I attend you morning and evening with no way to act on my own; I have repeatedly missed court sessions and neglected the thread of my studies.
translations.idiomatic: Recently I have suffered from wind deficiency; following Your Majesty's gracious order I was not permitted to force myself, and in addition I attend you morning and evening with no way to act on my own; I have repeatedly missed court sessions and neglected the thread of my studies.

sentences.zh: 觀尋來請，良符宿志。

translations.literal: Reading your request, it accords well with my long-held wish.
translations.idiomatic: Reading your request, it accords well with my long-held wish.

sentences.zh: 自非義均弼諧，渠能進此藥石？」

translations.literal: Unless righteousness were equal to that of an assisting minister, who could offer such salutary counsel?"
translations.idiomatic: Unless righteousness were equal to that of an assisting minister, who could offer such salutary counsel?"

sentences.zh: 文偉由是益知名。

translations.literal: Wenwei thereby became even more renowned.
translations.idiomatic: Wenwei thereby became even more renowned.

sentences.zh: 後右史缺，高宗謂侍臣曰：「文偉切諫吾兒，此直臣也。」

translations.literal: Later, when the Right Historiographer's post was vacant, Gaozong said to his attending ministers, "Wenwei remonstrated bluntly with my son—this is a straight-speaking minister.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the right historiographer's post was vacant, Gaozong said to his attending ministers, "Wenwei remonstrated bluntly with my son—this is a straight-speaking minister.

sentences.zh: 遂授之。

translations.literal: He was thereupon appointed to the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was thereupon appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 附 高子貢

translations.literal: Appendix: Gao Zigong
translations.idiomatic: Appendix: Gao Zigong

sentences.zh: 高子貢，善《太史書》，與硃敬則善，擢明經。

translations.literal: Gao Zigong was skilled in the Grand Scribe's Records; he was on good terms with Zhu Jingze and passed the mingjing examination.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Zigong was skilled in the Grand Scribe's Records; he was on good terms with Zhu Jingze and passed the mingjing examination.

sentences.zh: 曆秘書省正字、弘文館直學士。

translations.literal: He successively served as Proofreader of the Secretariat and Direct Academician of the Hongwen Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as proofreader of the secretariat and direct academician of the Hongwen Institute.

sentences.zh: 不得志，因棄官去。

translations.literal: Unsuccessful in his ambitions, he therefore resigned his office and left.
translations.idiomatic: Unsuccessful in his ambitions, he therefore resigned his office and left.

sentences.zh: 徐敬業起兵，弟敬猷統兵五千逼和州，子貢率鄉人數百拒之，賊引去。

translations.literal: When Xu Jingye raised troops, his younger brother Jingyou commanded five thousand men and pressed He Prefecture; Zigong led several hundred villagers to resist them, and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Xu Jingye raised troops, his younger brother Jingyou commanded five thousand men and pressed He Prefecture; Zigong led several hundred villagers to resist them, and the rebels withdrew.

sentences.zh: 以功擢朝散大夫，為成均助教。

translations.literal: For his merit he was promoted to Grand Master of Palace Leisure and appointed assistant director of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to grand master of palace leisure and appointed assistant director of the directorate of education.

sentences.zh: 東莞公融嘗為和州刺史，從子貢受業。

translations.literal: Duke of Dongguan Rong had once been prefect of He Prefecture and studied under Zigong.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Dongguan Rong had once been prefect of He Prefecture and studied under Zigong.

sentences.zh: 及融謀舉兵，令黃公譔見子貢，推為謀主，書疏往返，因結諸王內應。

translations.literal: When Rong plotted to raise troops, he sent Huang Gongpu to see Zigong and urged him to serve as chief strategist; letters went back and forth, and through this he linked up with various princes for internal support.
translations.idiomatic: When Rong plotted to raise troops, he sent Huang Gongpu to see Zigong and urged him to serve as chief strategist; letters went back and forth, and through this he linked up with various princes for internal support.

sentences.zh: 謀泄，坐死。

translations.literal: When the plot was exposed, he was executed for the offense.
translations.idiomatic: When the plot was exposed, he was executed for the offense.
